name: Idaten Ikase Otoko 3 ~Sengo Hen~
original_name: 韋駄天いかせ男３ ～戦後編～
source:
Japan is occupied after the end of the World War II. Hero is a soldier who does not speak Japanese, but has an ability to excite girls with random phrases alone.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
第二次世界大战结束后，日本处于占领之下。主人公是一名不会说日语的士兵，却拥有仅凭胡乱说些话便让女孩兴奋的能力。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
